title: Playback manifest fetch with origin timeout
name: Playback manifest service

questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code bounds the time spent waiting on the origin? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
The origin is completely unreachable and every fetch is aborted by the timer. A manifest for the asset was cached 2 minutes ago. What does a client receive?
choices: A 504 with origin_timeout, because the cached entry is older than FRESH_MS
The cached manifest, filtered by maxBandwidth, after roughly the timeout elapses
The cached manifest immediately, without contacting the origin

questions.prompt: The origin responds quickly with HTTP 503. A stale cached manifest exists. What happens?
choices: The stale manifest is served, because any origin failure falls back to the cache
The request is retried until the timeout expires

questions.prompt: A player requests maxBandwidth=500000 and every rendition in the manifest has a higher bandwidth. What does the response contain?
choices: The first rendition from the manifest only
A 400 error for an unsatisfiable bandwidth
